models.name: openWakeWord melspectrogram (16 kHz log-Mel front-end)
models.notes: openWakeWord Mel front-end (Apache-2.0); 16 kHz log-Mel. Byte-identical to the hey-buddy re-host. Served from the module assets dir (ADR-025).

models.name: Google speech_embedding backbone (re-implemented in openWakeWord)
models.notes: Google speech_embedding backbone re-implemented in openWakeWord (Apache-2.0, ~1.4M params). Byte-identical to the hey-buddy re-host. Local prebuilt.

models.name: Hey Buddy wake-word model (hey buddy)
models.notes: Browser-first wake-word model. Commercially clean (CC-BY-4.0). Replaces the CC BY-NC-SA openWakeWord alexa demo model. Fetched from the GitHub Release models-openwakeword-v1 (ADR-027; `pnpm fetch:all`).

models.name: Silero VAD (voice activity detection)
models.notes: Gates KWS to reduce compute and false alarms. Local prebuilt (bundled in openWakeWord release). Not loaded in v1 (RNNoise VAD is used, ADR-018).

models.name: microWakeWord demo model (e.g. 'okay_nabu')
models.notes: Used as a browser-demo MCU model until Phase 5 trains a WakeStudio-owned word.
